=== AWS AGENTCORE === (2 findings — both from the UNAUDITED harness subpage backlog)
release-notes: NO new October heading. Still only "Gateway: Private certificate authority
  support for targets" (reported 10-06). September headings unchanged.
data-plane API: not re-fetched; was byte-identical at 68 ops on 10-06.
bedrock doc-history: not re-fetched (newest was 09-29).
REPORTED:
  * harness-export.html — `agentcore export harness --arn|--name`. Managed harness ->
    editable Strands PYTHON. Build types CodeZip (default) / Container. Carries over:
    model provider config INCLUDING API KEY REFERENCES, remote MCP tools, Gateways,
    inline function tools, AgentCore Browser, Code Interpreter, built-in `shell` and
    `file_operations`, memory, execution limits, truncation, skills (Path/S3/Git),
    filesystem mounts (session storage/EFS/S3), AUTHORIZER CONFIGURATION.
    Deployable SELF-HOSTED: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, EC2, Kubernetes, ON-PREMISE, any
    container host, Python 3.12+. => governance escape hatch. Writes EXPORT_NOTES.md.
    Strands only today; "Claude Agents SDK coming soon".
  * harness-memory.html — MANAGED MEMORY AUTO-PROVISIONED when harness created via
    SERVICE API with memory config OMITTED. CLI defaults the OPPOSITE way (disabled).
    Strategies: SEMANTIC, SUMMARIZATION, USER_PREFERENCE, EPISODIC. Namespaces
    actorId-scoped e.g. /summary/{actorId}/{sessionId}/. Retrieval AUTOMATIC, no config,
    topK=10 relevanceScore=0.2, injected before reasoning. actorId is a CALLER-SUPPLIED
    string at invoke_harness time, not an authenticated principal => isolation rests on
    caller input. Managed memory CANNOT be deleted via Memory APIs; DeleteHarness
    CASCADE-DELETES it unless deleteManagedMemory=false. BYO = agentCoreMemoryConfiguration
    (needed for custom namespaces, KMS, sharing across harnesses). Truncation:
    sliding_window (default) / summarization / none.
UNAUDITED HARNESS SUBPAGES REMAINING: harness-versioning, harness-environment,
  harness-models, harness-get-started#api-documentation. (harness-skills seen via
  export page cross-ref but not opened directly.)
aws_q_*: not fetched. Dead 17+ scans. RETIREMENT RECOMMENDED.

=== OPENAI === (1 finding)
developers.openai.com/api/docs/changelog literal Oct list: 10-06 Decisions API beta w/
  gpt-6-luna; 10-06 usage tiers 5->3 (Build/Launch/Grow); 10-05 HIPAA BAA in-product flow.
  (Sept list unchanged from 10-06 scan.)
learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog literal list: 10-05 Codex CLI 0.160.1; 10-02 iOS
  1.2026.267; 10-01 Codex CLI 0.160.0. NO MOVEMENT since last scan.
REPORTED:
  * DECISIONS API NOW CALLABLE. POST /v1/decisions, model gpt-6-luna ONLY.
    Request: model + input (text OR user messages w/ input_text + input_image parts) +
    questions[] (type, instructions, optional choices/levels).
    Types: predicate (probability 0-1) / choice (value + probabilities + confidence) /
    score (prob-weighted avg over ordered levels + per-level probabilities + confidence).
    Images MUST be inline base64 data URLs — http(s) URLs and file IDs UNSUPPORTED
    (contrast Perplexity, which DOES fetch public URLs server-side).
    Multiple independent questions per shared input in one call. Refusals possible.
    Pricing $0.10/1M input; NO CHARGE for output or cache r/w => priced for per-hop use.
    Supports ZDR, HIPAA, data residency, US + EU regional processing.
  Doc: developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/decisions
NOT REPORTED: usage tier consolidation (billing).
CROSS-VENDOR DECISION-ENDPOINT PATTERN now 3 vendors: OpenAI (/v1/decisions, gpt-6-luna),
  Perplexity (/v1/decisions, pplx-decider-v1-27b), Microsoft Foundry (announced DevDay,
  surface not yet located — WATCH FOR IT ON A PRIMARY-TIER PLATFORM).

=== GOOGLE GEMINI ENTERPRISE === (1 finding)
release-notes literal Oct list: 10-06 (Antigravity feature access control, GA); 10-02
  (federated query mode + Knowledge Catalog, Preview); 10-01 x2 (Gemini 2.5 Pro removal
  Canada/Japan 10-20; web app toggle). 10-02 and 10-01 already reported 10-06.
REPORTED:
  * ANTIGRAVITY BOOST + TEAMWORK admin access controls (GA).
    Boost = /boost, tiered multi-agent hierarchy for deep debugging / algorithmic work.
    Teamwork = SENTINEL (coordinator) spawns PROJECT ORCHESTRATOR, which breaks an
      approved brief into milestones and delegates to EXPLORERS (read-only repo research,
      call-chain tracing, no source edits) and WORKERS (terminal + file tools, build,
      refactor, write tests). Parallel tracks, per-agent scratch spaces, file-ownership
      arbitration so two workers never edit one file.
      Workspace: ~/teamwork_projects/{PROJECT_NAME}.
      HUMAN GATE IS PHASE 1 ONLY (approve the generated brief); execution then autonomous.
      Admin can ENFORCE WORKSPACE SANDBOXING and RESTRICT BROWSER / MCP SERVER PERMISSIONS.
    NOTE: docs live on antigravity.google/docs/*, NOT on docs.cloud.google.com.
      Guessed URL docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/antigravity-access-control
      404s. Resolve Antigravity doc paths via WebSearch.
    Antigravity ITSELF was reported Aug 2026 (reports/report-2026-08-21, -08-30);
      Boost/Teamwork/subagents were NOT.
